title: Autumn [Sharad R^itu] eulogised
introduction: Rama's exaltation of sharad R^itu post-rainy or pre-autumnal season is the theme here. This season, which will be conducive to lovers, is painful to Rama in the absence of Seetha. This agony is compounding and turning into his ire, since Sugreeva's efforts in searching for Seetha are neither seen nor heard. Hence, Rama sends Lakshmana as an envoy to Kishkindha to decide whether Sugreeva's support is there or liquefied in the spree of his drinking and merrymaking.

A word about this chapter. Readers acquainted with critical version of Ramayana may find some 35 verses in this chapter that are unknown to them. They occur in all the other traditional versions and they carry the blemish of interpolation. They are inescapable in traditional versions, as age-old commentators have commented on them at length.
closing: The word budhyate means 'waking up' apart from 'knowing' etc. Thus, 'earlier, when I was with Seetha I used to know myself as the 'Being' as and when her divine and swanlike voice used to address me, which voice is incidentally equals the hymn Gayatri, and which I used to hear continuously. But now without her, Shri, Goddess Lakshmi, I am presently not able to know myself.'
इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे त्रिंश सर्गः
Thus, this is the 30th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
गुहाम् प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः |
वर्ष रात्रे स्थितो रामः काम शोक अभिपीडितः
पाण्डुरम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा विमलम् चन्द्र मण्डलम् |
शारदीम् रजनीम् चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्न अनुलेपनाम्
काम वृत्तम् च सुग्रीवम् नष्टाम् च जनक आत्मजाम् |
दृष्ट्वा कालम् अतीतम् च मुमोह परम आतुरः
verses.iast:
guhām praviṣṭe sugrīve vimukte gagane ghanaiḥ |
varṣa rātre sthito rāmaḥ kāma śoka abhipīḍitaḥ
pāṇḍuram gaganam dṛṣṭvā vimalam candra maṇḍalam |
śāradīm rajanīm caiva dṛṣṭvā jyotsna anulepanām
kāma vṛttam ca sugrīvam naṣṭām ca janaka ātmajām |
dṛṣṭvā kālam atītam ca mumoha parama āturaḥ
verses.translation: On Sugreeva's entering the cave-like Kishkindha, Rama who spent rainy nights on that mountain with much distress owing to the misery of yearning for Seetha, has seen the immaculate sphere of moon on silvern sky freed by ceasing rains, and even autumnal nights that are enamelled with moonshine, and thus he observed that Seetha is lost hopelessly, engrossed in lust Sugreeva is lost to world intractably, and furthermore time too is being lost irretrievably, and thus he became highly impatient and even swooned.

glosses.meaning: sky, of clouds, while releasing - while rains are ceasing
of yearning, by misery, verily, distressed
staying - who spent rainy nights during his stay
in lust, engrossed, of Sugreeva, also
lost - hopeless, of Janaka's, daughter - of Seetha, also

verses.devanagari:
स तु संज्ञाम् उपागम्य मुहूर्तात् मतिमान् नृपः |
मनः स्थाम् अपि वैदेहीम् चिंतयामास राघवः
verses.iast:
sa tu saṃjñām upāgamya muhūrtāt matimān nṛpaḥ |
manaḥ sthām api vaidehīm ciṃtayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: But on getting consciousness in a moment, that thoughtful king Raghava started to think of Vaidehi who is abiding in his heart, though not at his side.

glosses.meaning: in heart, abiding, though, of Vaidehi

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा च विमलम् व्योम गत विद्युत् बलाहकम् |
सारस आरव संघुष्टम् विललाप आर्तया गिरा
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca vimalam vyoma gata vidyut balāhakam |
sārasa ārava saṅghuṣṭam vilalāpa ārtayā girā
verses.translation: On seeing the sky to be spic and span when set free of black-clouds and lightning, and even vibrant with the shrieks of Saarasa birds, Rama bemoaned in woeful words.

glosses.meaning: one which is - set free, of electric-discharges [lightning,] dark-clouds
with Saarasa birds, shrieks, [now] vibrant with

verses.devanagari:
आसीनः पर्वतस्य अग्रे हेम धातु विभूषिते |
शारदम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा जगाम मनसा प्रियाम्
verses.iast:
āsīnaḥ parvatasya agre hema dhātu vibhūṣite |
śāradam gaganam dṛṣṭvā jagāma manasā priyām
verses.translation: Rama's concepts are on the rove towards his ladylove when he beheld the skyscape of autumn while sitting on the summit of a mountain that is embellished with gold and other ores, and he soliloquised his thoughts in this way.

glosses.meaning: journeyed - on the rove [and he soliloquised his thoughts in this way.]

verses.devanagari:
सारस आरव संनादैः सारस आरव नादिनी |
या आश्रमे रमते बाला सा अद्य मे रमते कथम्
verses.iast:
sārasa ārava saṃnādaiḥ sārasa ārava nādinī |
yā āśrame ramate bālā sā adya me ramate katham
verses.translation: "Young Seetha with a voice that is a soundalike to the callings of Saarasa birds used to take delight in these resonant calls of Saarasa birds when we were together in hermitage, but how she might be taking delight in these chirrups now without me.
notes: When we were in hermitage, on listening the callings of Saarasa birds, Seetha used to call me to observe these birds in a voice that soundalike the Saarasa birds, and we were delighted to listen the callings of those birds together. But now staying among demons how can she take delight in seeing these seasonal birds or call me for help with such a voice, because her voice is lost in the blare of bawling demons.

glosses.meaning: Saarasa bird-like, callings, sounding - alike, Seetha
Saarasa birds, callings, with the resonance of
now, how, she can delight herself without me.

verses.devanagari:
पुष्पिताम् च आसनान् दृष्ट्वा कांचनान् इव निर्मलान् |
कथम् सा रमते बाला पश्यंती माम् अपश्यती
verses.iast:
puṣpitām ca āsanān dṛṣṭvā kāṃcanān iva nirmalān |
katham sā ramate bālā paśyaṃtī mām apaśyatī
verses.translation: "On seeing the flawless Asana trees flowered as if with golden flowers, she checks up for my availability thereabout, but now finding me nowhere near her, how can she be happy.
notes: On seeing these flowers Seetha used to go near the trees to check their beauty, and even used to check up for my availability to show their beauty to me. Now if she sees these seasonal flowers in that place where she is captivated, at least for a moment, but if she does no find me there, she looses her heart for these flowers.

glosses.meaning: Asana trees [Terminalia alata tomentosa, Bandhuuka trees]
for me - while seeing, checking up for me
me, not, seeing - not finding me

verses.devanagari:
या पुरा कलहंसानाम् स्वरेण कल भाषिणी |
बुध्यते चारु सर्वांगी सा अद्य मे रमते कथम्
verses.iast:
yā purā kalahaṃsānām svareṇa kala bhāṣiṇī |
budhyate cāru sarvāṃgī sā adya me ramate katham
verses.translation: "She who is enchanting to me by her well-proportioned limbs that clucky-voiced Seetha earlier used to wake me up in tune with the melodious callings of clucking-swans, but how that ladylove of mine might be amusing herself now.
notes: 'Earlier when in hermitage Seetha used to wake me up with her clucky-voice synchronising with the clucking of swans. On my awakening, I used to see her auspicious face and all-charming physique, by that I daily used to have a waking up protocol, suprabhāta seva, now how she can do it or how I can enjoy her sight every morning.

glosses.meaning: my, she - she who is mine

verses.devanagari:
निःस्वनम् चक्रवाकानाम् निशम्य सहचारिणाम् |
पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षी कथम् एषा भविष्यति
verses.iast:
niḥsvanam cakravākānām niśamya sahacāriṇām |
puṇḍarīkaviśālākṣī katham eṣā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "On hearing the sharp notes of Cakravaka birds that always move together in couples, what will become of this white-lotus-like broad-eyed Seetha, since she is not together with me.

glosses.meaning: [that always] together - in couples, moving, of Cakravaka birds
out, cry - sharp notes, on listening
how, she, will be - what becomes of her.

verses.devanagari:
सरांसि सरितो वापीः काननानि वनानि च |
ताम् विना मृगशावाक्षीम् चरन् न अद्य सुखम् लभे
verses.iast:
sarāṃsi sarito vāpīḥ kānanāni vanāni ca |
tām vinā mṛgaśāvākṣīm caran na adya sukham labhe
verses.translation: "I am not able to enjoy myself without that deer-eyed lady though wandering around enjoyable lakes, rivers, tanks, forests and woodlands, whose thirst is drenched by rainwater and my thirsting for her is not.

glosses.meaning: lakes, rivers, tanks - which are naturally enjoyable
joy, not, - I am - able to get.

verses.devanagari:
अपि ताम् मत् वियोगात् च सौकुमार्यात् च भामिनीम् |
सुदूरम् पीडयेत् कामः शरत् गुण निरंतरः
verses.iast:
api tām mat viyogāt ca saukumāryāt ca bhāminīm |
sudūram pīḍayet kāmaḥ śarat guṇa niraṃtaraḥ
verses.translation: "The Love-god with a plethora of provocative autumnal features will be prolongedly agonising her, because she is separated from me, and because her ladyship is a frailty - won't he?" Thus Rama worried for Seetha.
notes: 'Will the Love-god Manmatha, with all his paraphernalia of licentious autumnal aspects, like even-climate, even-circumstance and even-desire, will he leave Seetha? Even on knowing fully well that she is separated from me besides being a delicate person, will that Love-god leave her alone? No, He will not... for, merciless is that Manmatha, God of Love, and He may agonise Seetha till death, for she is an unyielding woman to others pati vrata , nor I am at her side.'

glosses.meaning: autumnal, features, without, gap - with plethora of provocative features of autumn
will agonise, is it - won't he.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् आदि नरश्रेष्ठो विललाप नृपात्मजः |
विहंग इव सारंगः सलिलम् त्रिदशेश्वरात्
verses.iast:
evam ādi naraśreṣṭho vilalāpa nṛpātmajaḥ |
vihaṅga iva sāraṃgaḥ salilam tridaśeśvarāt
verses.translation: So on and so forth that best one among men and the son of a king keened over, like a Rain-cuckoo which will be keen on Indra, the king of divinities, for rainy-water.
notes: The Caataka or Saaranga birds are said to be a sort of bird-flock which thrive on rain water alone, but not on water in rivers or brooks. They fly up to skies to swill the water directly from clouds granted by Indra. So also Rama is desirous of Seetha alone for his theory is 'one-man-one-wife.' Thereby he does not eye other women. In epical aesthetics this is called anukūla nāyaka lakśaṇa 'hero in harmony.'

glosses.meaning: divinities, from the king of - from Indra

verses.devanagari:
ततः चंचूर्य रम्येषु फलार्थी गिरि सानुषु |
ददर्श पर्युपावृत्तो लक्ष्मीवान् लक्ष्मणो अग्रजम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ caṃcūrya ramyeṣu phalārthī giri sānuṣu |
dadarśa paryupāvṛtto lakṣmīvān lakṣmaṇo agrajam
verses.translation: Meandering on the pleasant mountain-terraces in search of fruits brilliant Lakshmana returned and has seen his elder brother Rama.

glosses.meaning: fruits, seeker - one gone in search of
at his elder brother, has seen.

verses.devanagari:
स चिन्तया दुस्सहया परीतम्
विसंज्ञम् एकम् विजने मनस्वी |
भ्रातुर् विषादात् त्वरितो अति दीनः
समीक्ष्य सौमित्रिः उवाच रामम्
verses.iast:
sa cintayā dussahayā parītam
visaṃjñam ekam vijane manasvī |
bhrātur viṣādāt tvarito ati dīnaḥ
samīkṣya saumitriḥ uvāca rāmam
verses.translation: Noble-hearted Saumitri, on observing lone Rama in a lonely place, who is beset with unbearable sadness and whose posture is vacuous, became very miserable for the sad condition of his brother, and spoke to Rama fretfully.

glosses.meaning: without, awareness - with a vacuous posture

verses.devanagari:
किम् आर्य कामस्य वशम् गतेन
किम् आत्म पौरुष्य पराभवेन |
अयम् ह्रिया संह्रियते समाधिः
किम् अत्र योगेन निवर्तितेन
verses.iast:
kim ārya kāmasya vaśam gatena
kim ātma pauruṣya parābhavena |
ayam hriyā saṃhriyate samādhiḥ
kim atra yogena nivartitena
verses.translation: "Oh, noble one, what is the use in getting into fetters of passion, what for soul's bold-temper is being trounced, this remorseful sadness is arrogating self-assurance, and what purpose can be achieved now in retracing steps from the goal.
notes: 'The time when one has to keep up his bold-temper, without subjugation to passional temperance has arrived now, namely the autumn, and now loosing heart to shameful sadness, and loosing manly boldness to seasonal passions... what purpose can be achieved by it?' Maheshvara Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: now, with reverted, association - with the aim, by retracing your steps from the goal]

verses.devanagari:
क्रियाभियोगम् मनसः प्रसादम्
समाधि योग अनुगतम् च कालम् |
सहाय सामर्थ्यम् अदीन सत्त्वः
स्व कर्म हेतुम् च कुरुष्व तात
verses.iast:
kriyābhiyogam manasaḥ prasādam
samādhi yoga anugatam ca kālam |
sahāya sāmarthyam adīna sattvaḥ
sva karma hetum ca kuruṣva tāta
verses.translation: "Oh, dear sir, engage yourself in your mission with an undeterred spirit and with a good disposition of mind, and bring time under control with steadfastness and ideation, and the capabilities of your helpmates, say Sugreeva and others be gathered, and the basis for your achievements, say daily rituals towards gods, be performed by you as your means.

glosses.meaning: concentration [steadfastness,] yogic thinking [ideation,] following [in accordance with,] also
helpmate's, capabilities [kuruSva = be gathered by you]
your own, endeavour [daily rituals to gods,] also

verses.devanagari:
न जानकी मानव वंश नाथ
त्वया सनाथा सुलभा परेण |
न च अग्नि चूडाम् ज्वलिताम् उपेत्य
न दह्यते वीर वरार्ह कश्चित्
verses.iast:
na jānakī mānava vaṃśa nātha
tvayā sanāthā sulabhā pareṇa |
na ca agni cūḍām jvalitām upetya
na dahyate vīra varārha kaścit
verses.translation: "Oh, the lord of human kindred, with you as her husband Janaki is not an easily attainable one for others, oh, highly honourable one, if it is said that none will be burnt if he nears the tongues of flaming fire, oh, brave one, it is not so, for Janaki is a flaming fire, and anyone nearing her in ill-will will be burnt to ashes like a grass-hopper." Thus Lakshmana said to Rama.

glosses.meaning: oh, for high honour, eligible one - oh, Rama
thus, if said, no - not so.

verses.devanagari:
सलक्षणम् लक्ष्मणम् अप्रधृष्यम्
स्वभावजम् वाक्यम् उवाच रामः |
हितम् च पथ्यम् च नय प्रसक्तम्
ससाम धर्मार्थ समाहितम् च
verses.iast:
salakṣaṇam lakṣmaṇam apradhṛṣyam
svabhāvajam vākyam uvāca rāmaḥ |
hitam ca pathyam ca naya prasaktam
sasāma dharmārtha samāhitam ca
verses.translation:
Lakshmana with his seemliness spoke those undeniable and expedient words that emerged from his very nature, which are tasteful, morally abiding, and further abounding with friendliness, righteousness, and meaningfulness, and on listening such words Rama spoke to Lakshmana.

Rama spoke to seemly and undeniable Lakshmana with words that emerged from his very nature, which are tasteful, morally abiding, and further abounding with friendliness, righteousness, and meaningfulness.

verses.devanagari:
निस्संशयम् कार्यम् अवेक्षितव्यम्
क्रिया विशेषो अपि अनुवर्तितव्यः |
न तु प्रवृद्धस्य दुरासदस्य
कुमार वीर्यस्य फलम् च चिन्त्यम्
verses.iast:
nissaṃśayam kāryam avekṣitavyam
kriyā viśeṣo api anuvartitavyaḥ |
na tu pravṛddhasya durāsadasya
kumāra vīryasya phalam ca cintyam
verses.translation: "Doubtless accomplishment of the task is to be held in view, even oh, boy, the factors that contribute to its accomplishment, like enthusiasm, helpmates etc., are to be followed through, and not only these aspects but we also have to observe the fruition of task when that task is becoming unwieldy, unattainable and formidable, along with the lapse of time and lapsing of help." Thus Rama said to Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: accomplishment [of task,] is to be kept in view
task's, factors, even, in tow, are to be followed

verses.devanagari:
अथ पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मैथिलीम् अनुचिन्तयन् |
उवाच लक्ष्मणम् रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता
verses.iast:
atha padma palāśa akṣīm maithilīm anucintayan |
uvāca lakṣmaṇam rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā
verses.translation: On thinking about the fruit of his mammoth task, namely that lotus-petal-eyed Maithili, thereafter Rama spoke to Lakshmana with a dried-up face.

verses.devanagari:
तर्पयित्वा सहस्राक्षः सलिलेन वसुंधराम् |
निर्वर्तयित्वा सस्यानि कृत कर्मा व्यवस्थितः
verses.iast:
tarpayitvā sahasrākṣaḥ salilena vasundharām |
nirvartayitvā sasyāni kṛta karmā vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: "On satisfying mother earth with rainwater and on effectuating the crops on earth, the Thousand-eyed Indra is complacent as his task is effectuated, whereas my task is yet to take off.
notes: Here a selfless philanthropist who accords benefits on his own without any petition or prayer is suggested in referring to Indra and rains, and Rama has not yet done such act in respect of Seetha.

glosses.meaning: with waters, mother earth, on oblating - satisfying
on accomplishing, his task, is complacent.

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घ गंभीर निर्घोषाः शैल द्रुम पुरोगमाः |
विसृज्य सलिलम् मेघाः परिश्रांता नृप आत्मज
verses.iast:
dīrgha gambhīra nirghoṣāḥ śaila druma purogamāḥ |
visṛjya salilam meghāḥ pariśrāṃtā nṛpa ātmaja
verses.translation: "Clouds roving on the tops of mountains and trees with their protracted and profound peals have let the water loose and they are now retired, oh, prince, but tireless are rumbles and grumbles in my heart, thus I cannot retire.

verses.devanagari:
नील उत्पल दल श्यामः श्यामी कृत्वा दिशो दश |
विमदा इव मातंगाः शान्त वेगाः पयो धराः
verses.iast:
nīla utpala dala śyāmaḥ śyāmī kṛtvā diśo daśa |
vimadā iva mātaṃgāḥ śānta vegāḥ payo dharāḥ
verses.translation: "On blackening ten quarters of earth blue-black clouds that looked like petals of blue-lotuses are now quietened in their nimbleness like rut-less elephants.
notes: There are eight elephants carrying the universe from its eight corners aṣṭa diggaja-s. They and the elephantine-clouds that give waters, both kinds of elephants are responsible for world's sustenance, but they now are nonchalant on performing their duties, along with their administrator Indra. Rama is not able to do his duty due to slackness of Sugreeva, and thus he is questioning himself whether his mission / incarnation is going to be futile or worthwhile.

verses.devanagari:
जल गर्भा महा वेगाः कुटज अर्जुन गंधिनः |
चरित्वा विरताः सौम्य वृष्टि वाताः समुद्यताः
verses.iast:
jala garbhā mahā vegāḥ kuṭaja arjuna gaṃdhinaḥ |
caritvā viratāḥ saumya vṛṣṭi vātāḥ samudyatāḥ
verses.translation: "Now pausing are the high-speeded rainy-winds, which once speedily swooped with water in their wombs, and wafted the fragrance of Kutaja and Arjuna flowers.

verses.devanagari:
घनानाम् वारणानाम् च मयूराणाम् च लक्ष्मण |
नादः प्रस्रवणानाम् च प्रशान्तः सहसा अनघ
verses.iast:
ghanānām vāraṇānām ca mayūrāṇām ca lakṣmaṇa |
nādaḥ prasravaṇānām ca praśāntaḥ sahasā anagha
verses.translation: "The rales of clouds, elephants, peacocks, and oh, merited Lakshmana, of the freshets too, are suddenly quietened.

verses.devanagari:
अभिवृष्टा महा मेघैः निर्मलाः चित्र सानवः |
अनुलिप्ता इव आभान्ति गिरयः चन्द्र रश्मिभिः
verses.iast:
abhivṛṣṭā mahā meghaiḥ nirmalāḥ citra sānavaḥ |
anuliptā iva ābhānti girayaḥ candra raśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: "Scoured well by rains from colossal clouds those amusing mountain terraces are grime-less and they shine forth as though enamelled with the moonbeams.

verses.devanagari:
शाखासु सप्त च्छद पादपानाम्
प्रभासु तार अर्क निशा कराणाम् |
लीलासु चैव उत्तम वारणानाम्
श्रियम् विभज्य अद्य शरत् प्रवृत्ता
verses.iast:
śākhāsu sapta cchada pādapānām
prabhāsu tāra arka niśā karāṇām |
līlāsu caiva uttama vāraṇānām
śriyam vibhajya adya śarat pravṛttā
verses.translation: "Presently autumn has shown itself dividing its charm on the branches of seven-leaved banana plants, on the stars, sun and moon, and also on those best elephants that are rollicking.
notes: The seven-leaved banana plants are bearing whitish-buds, the luminosity of sun, moon and stars is blanched and because such a congenial atmosphere of autumn is prevailing the elephants are frolicking, since no other season can make those pachyderms joyous.

glosses.meaning: seven, covered [by leaves,] of plants [the banana plants covered by their seven leaves] on branches
of stars, sun, night, maker [moon,] in their brilliance
of best, elephants, frolicking, also thus
charm, on dividing, has shown itself.

verses.devanagari:
संप्रति अनेक आश्रय चित्र शोभा
लक्ष्मीः शरत् काल गुण उपपन्ना |
सूर्य अग्र हस्त प्रतिबोधितेषु
पद्माकरेषु अभ्यधिकम् विभाति
verses.iast:
samprati aneka āśraya citra śobhā
lakśmīḥ śarat kāla guṇa upapannā |
sūrya agra hasta pratibodhiteṣu
padmākareṣu abhyadhikam vibhāti
verses.translation: "Fascinatingly glistening grandeur of autumn that is derived from the merits of the season and that resorts to many objects of the season, is now splendidly shining in the lotus lakes that are flourished by the rays of dawning sun.
notes: Those that are graced by the Almighty, their splendidly glistening visages are indicated by the gleaming lotuses. In autumn the sun does not scorch, thus by his first rays awakened are the pink, blue, and white lotuses, and there are many such lotus-lakes, which also gleam with their gleaming lotuses, and thus 'Lakshmi' - the affluence, splendour, grandeur, of nature is glorified through the sage-like lotuses' bloom.

glosses.meaning: many, resorting to, which is fascinating, which is glistening
autumnal, season's, merits of, derived from
sun's, first [dawning,] by hands [by rays,] in turn, made known [awakened, flourished]

verses.devanagari:
सप्त च्छदानाम् कुसुमोप गंधी
षट् पाद वृन्दैः अनुगीयमानः |
मत्त द्विपानाम् पवन अनुसारी
दर्पम् विनेष्यन् अधिकम् विभाति
verses.iast:
sapta cchadānām kusumopa gaṃdhī
ṣaṭ pāda vṛndaiḥ anugīyamānaḥ |
matta dvipānām pavana anusārī
darpam vineṣyan adhikam vibhāti
verses.translation: "The breeze is wafting the fragrance of flowers of seven-leaved banana plants, and the swarms of honeybees that are singing in accompaniment to the rustle of breeze are tagging along that breeze for its fragrance, and because that breeze is breezing unceasingly, that alone is fetching the pride of rut for the already rutted elephants, and thus this autumnal season is highly glistening.

glosses.meaning: six, footed ones [hexapods, honeybees,] by swarms of
seven, leaves-covered [banana plants,] flower's, covered, fragrance [is wafted by the breeze]
of rutted, elephants, pride of rut

verses.devanagari:
अभ्यागतैः चारु विशाल पक्षैः
सरः प्रियैः पद्म रजो अवकीर्णैः |
महा नदीनाम् पुलिन उपयातैः
क्रीडन्ति हंसाः सह चक्रवाकैः
verses.iast:
abhyāgataiḥ cāru viśāla pakśaiḥ
saraḥ priyaiḥ padma rajo avakīrṇaiḥ |
mahā nadīnām pulina upayātaiḥ
krīḍanti haṃsāḥ saha cakravākaiḥ
verses.translation: "Broad and cute winged Cakravaka birds that are fond of lakes and that have pollen of lotuses overspread on them have come to the sand-dunes of vast rivers, and with them that have come nigh the swans are larking.
notes: Swans and Cakravaka birds are said to be born enemies. But due to autumnal effect, they have stopped their infighting and came together on the sand dunes, for their mating games.

glosses.meaning: Cakravaka birds, along with, they are larking.

verses.devanagari:
मद प्रगल्भेषु च वारिणेषु
गवाम् समूहेषु च दर्पितेषु |
प्रसन्न तोयासु च निम्न गासु
विभाति लक्ष्मीः बहुधा विभक्ता
verses.iast:
mada pragalbheṣu ca vāriṇeṣu
gavām samūheṣu ca dar.hpiteṣu |
prasanna toyāsu ca nimna gāsu
vibhāti lakśmīḥ bahudhā vibhaktā
verses.translation: "Divided variously the autumnal glory is shining forth among the overbearingly ruttish elephants that are trumpeting, among the herds of haughty bulls bellowing, and among the limpid waters that are murmuringly slopping down.

glosses.meaning: haughty ones, in bulls, herds of
in limpid, waters, also, to slope, going - that are slopping down

verses.devanagari:
नभः समीक्ष्या अंबु धरैः विमुक्तम्
विमुक्त बर्ह आभरणा वनेषु |
प्रियासु अरक्ता विनिवृत्त शोभा
गत उत्सवा ध्यान परा मयूराः
verses.iast:
nabhaḥ samīkśyā ambu dharaiḥ vimuktam
vimukta barha ābharaṇā vaneṣu |
priyāsu araktā vinivṛtta śobhā
gata utsavā dhyāna parā mayūrāḥ
verses.translation: "Exploring the sky well which is now set free by the clouds, the peacocks are setting their ornamental plumaged-tails free, and they are even divested of their dear peahens as they are uninterested in them, and thus divested of their festivity those peacocks are abiding in their muse.
notes: Rama's musing is similar to that of the peacocks. Not that he is disinterested in Seetha, but his present priority is to conquer Ravana, for which Ravana is to be located first. Further, gone is the festivity to Rama, which chanced while befriending Sugreeva, who then was in a similar state, but now completely transformed into a frivolous monkey. Thus, Rama is pondering over the possibility of locating and conquering Ravana by himself, should Sugreeva refuse the pact.

glosses.meaning: verily, setting free, peacocks, of their ornaments - colourful tails

verses.devanagari:
मनोज्ञ गन्धैः प्रियकैः अनल्पैः
पुष्प अति भार अवनत अग्र शाखैः |
सुवर्ण गौरैः नयन अभिरामैः
उद्योतितान् इव वन अन्तराणि
verses.iast:
manojña gandhaiḥ priyakaiḥ analpaiḥ
puṣpa ati bhāra avanata agra śākhaiḥ |
suvarṇa gauraiḥ nayana abhirāmaiḥ
udyotitān iva vana antarāṇi
verses.translation: "Umpteen are those Priyaka trees with their pleasingly fragrant flowers, the apices of the boughs of those trees are sagging down by their much weighty flowers-bunches, and eye-delighting is the golden-yellow hue of those flowers, and with them the interiors of these forests look as though illuminated, lit with golden lamps.

glosses.itrans: puSpa ati bhaara ava nata agra shaakhaiH
glosses.iast: puṣpa ati bhāra ava nata agra śākhaiḥ
glosses.devanagari: पुष्प अति भार अव नत अग्र शाखैः
glosses.meaning: flowers, much, weighty, down, bent [sagged down,] apices, of boughs
with Priyaka flowers of Asana trees

verses.devanagari:
प्रिय अन्वितानाम् नलिनी प्रियाणाम्
वन प्रियाणाम् कुसुम उद्धतानाम् |
मद उत्कटानाम् मद लालसानाम्
गज उत्तमानम् गतयो अद्य मन्दाः
verses.iast:
priya anvitānām nalinī priyāṇām
vana priyāṇām kusuma uddhatānām |
mada utkaṭānām mada lālasānām
gaja uttamānam gatayo adya mandāḥ
verses.translation: "On scenting the fragrance of the seven-leaved banana plants, the ruttish lather of those best elephants that have a fond for forests and lotus-lakes has started to flow on their temples, thus they are indulgent in rut and their strides are slackening while they are moving along with their beloved female elephants.

glosses.meaning: dear ones, that are along with
by flowers, up-heaved - excited on smelling fragrance of flowers

verses.devanagari:
व्यक्तम् नभः शस्त्र विधौत वर्णम्
कृश प्रवाहानि नदी जलानि |
कह्लार शिताः पवनाः प्रवान्ति
तमो विमुक्ताः च दिशः प्रकाशाः
verses.iast:
vyaktam nabhaḥ śastra vidhauta varṇam
kṛśa pravāhāni nadī jalāni |
kahlāra śitāḥ pavanāḥ pravānti
tamo vimuktāḥ ca diśaḥ prakāśāḥ
verses.translation: "The sky is clear as with the tinge of just whetted weapon, lessened are the flows of river-waters, breeze is chilly while wafting the chillness of red-lotuses, and all the directions released from the darkness are looking bright.

glosses.itrans: tamaH vi muktaaH dishaH prakaashaaH ca
glosses.iast: tamaḥ vi muktāḥ diśaḥ prakāśāḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: तमः वि मुक्ताः दिशः प्रकाशाः च
glosses.meaning: from darkness, well, released, directions, are bright.

verses.devanagari:
सूर्य आतप क्रामण नष्ट पंका
भूमिः चिर उद्घाटित सांद्र रेणुः |
अन्योन्य वैरेण समायुतानाम्
उद्योग कालो अद्य नर अधिपानाम्
verses.iast:
sūrya ātapa krāmaṇa naṣṭa paṃkā
bhūmiḥ cira udghāṭita sāṃdra reṇuḥ |
anyonya vaireṇa samāyutānām
udyoga kālo adya nara adhipānām
verses.translation: "Overcome by the sun's heat dried out is the sludge, at last the earth is dense with the up-heaved dust, and for the lords of people who have mutual animosity this is the time to foregather their forces to strive against one another.

glosses.meaning: sun's, heat, by overcoming, lost [dried out,] sludge
after a long time [at last,] up-heaved, dense, dust

verses.devanagari:
शरत् गुण आप्यायित रूप शोभाः
प्रहर्षित पांशु समुक्षित अंगाः |
मद उत्कटाः संप्रति युद्ध लुब्धा
वृषा गवाम् मध्य गता नदन्ति
verses.iast:
śarat guṇa āpyāyita rūpa śobhāḥ
praharṣita pāṃśu samukśita aṃgāḥ |
mada utkaṭāḥ samprati yuddha lubdhā
vṛṣā gavām madhya gatā nadanti
verses.translation: "The nature of autumn has enhanced the features of bulls' bullishness and with their bodies covered with dust and their vigour pepping them up they are ecstatic, and staying in the midst of cowherd they are bellowing hankering for bullfights.

glosses.meaning: autumn, nature of, enhanced by, features [of bulls,] grandeur [of bulls, bullishness]
well-gladdened - ecstatic, with dust, covered, on limbs [bodies of nulls]

verses.devanagari:
स मन्मध तीव्रतर अनुरागा
कुलान्विता मन्द गतिः करेणुः |
मदान्वितम् संपरिवार्य यान्तम्
वनेषु भर्तारम् अनुप्रयाति
verses.iast:
sa manmadha tīvratara anurāgā
kulānvitā manda gatiḥ kareṇuḥ |
madānvitam samparivārya yāntam
vaneṣu bhartāram anuprayāti
verses.translation: "While a ruttish male elephant is going in the forest the slow paced she-elephant is tagging along her male along with other elephants of her breed, and with an intensified attachment and passion she is bumping and rubbing her husband.

glosses.meaning: class of elephants [homogenous,] along with - along with other she-elephants of the same order
well, encircling - rubbing and bumping into

verses.devanagari:
त्यक्त्वा वराणि आत्म विभूषणानि
बर्हाणि तीर उपगता नदीनाम् |
निर्भर्त्स्यमाना इव सार ओघैः
प्रयान्ति दीना विमना मयूराः
verses.iast:
tyaktvā varāṇi ātma vibhūṣaṇāni
barhāṇi tīra upagatā nadīnām |
nirbhartsyamānā iva sāra oghaiḥ
prayānti dīnā vimanā mayūrāḥ
verses.translation: "The excellent plumaged-tails that form their individual ornaments of peacocks are now cast out, and the plumeless peacocks on nearing the banks of rivers they look as if intimidated by the Saarasa birds, thus they had to turn back despondently and dispiritedly.
notes: The peacocks are like those that have enjoyed their fortunes once but now divested of them. Thus, they have to turn away from the newly fortunate Saarasa birds, whose fortune is enriched by this autumn, though they are inferior to peacocks in anyway. This is because the lusty twitters of Saarasa birds are more or less insulations to these one-time-fortunate peacocks. So also, should the one-time-fortunate Rama, be insulted by the newly fortunate Sugreeva?

glosses.meaning: excellent, plumaged-tails, on loosing - flaked out
of rivers, to riverbanks, arrived near

verses.devanagari:
वित्रास्य कारण्डव चक्रवाकान् |
महा रवैः भिन्न कटा गजेन्द्राः |
सरस्सु बद्ध अंबुज भूषणेषु
विक्षोभ्य विक्षोभ्य जलम् पिबन्ति
verses.iast:
vitrāsya kāraṇḍava cakravākān |
mahā ravaiḥ bhinna kaṭā gajendrāḥ |
sarassu baddha ambuja bhūṣaṇeṣu
vikśobhya vikśobhya jalam pibanti
verses.translation: "With their blaring trumpeting lordly elephants with slit temples are alarming Karandava and Cakravaka birds abiding in lakes that are embellished with blooming lotuses, and those elephants are drinking water after swishing and swashing the tranquillity of those lakes.
notes: The tranquillity of Rama's lake-like heart in which Seetha abides in blooming lotus is swished and swashed by a ruttish elephant, called Sugreeva, whose sudden fortune like the seasonal water in lakes, that too made available by Rama, is making him to swill only a few mouthfuls of watery toddy-liquor. For that Rama, who is flitting so far from forest to forest, is alarmed like the flitting birds called Kaarandava and Cakravaka-s.

glosses.meaning: bonded, [blooming,] with water, born [lotuses,] embellished with

verses.devanagari:
व्यपेत पंकजासु स वालुकासु
प्रसन्न तोयासु स गो कुलासु |
स सारसा राव विनादितासु
नदिषु हंसा निपतन्ति हृष्टाः
verses.iast:
vyapeta paṃkajāsu sa vālukāsu
prasanna toyāsu sa go kulāsu |
sa sārasā rāva vināditāsu
nadiṣu haṃsā nipatanti hṛṣṭāḥ
verses.translation: "De-silted is the silt of rivers and they are with sand-dunes and serene waters, and cow-stock is gathering there, besides, they are resonant with clucking of Saarasa birds, in such rivers swans are delightedly taking deep dives.

glosses.meaning: with, sand-dunes prasanna toyaasu = in serene, waters

verses.devanagari:
नदी घन प्रस्रवण उदकानाम्
अति प्रवृद्ध अनिल बर्हिणानाम् |
प्लवंगमानाम् च गत उत्सवानाम्
ध्रुवम् रवाः संप्रति संप्रणष्टाः
verses.iast:
nadī ghana prasravaṇa udakānām
ati pravṛddha anila barhiṇānām |
plavaṃgamānām ca gata utsavānām
dhruvam ravāḥ samprati sampraṇaṣṭāḥ
verses.translation: "The ruffles of rivers, rumbles of clouds, rattles of rapids, such rackets of waters are quietened, and much amplified gusts of wind, and screams of peacocks along with crocks of frogs, are now completely undone as their festivity is definitely lost with the rains.

verses.devanagari:
अनेक वर्णाः सुविनष्ट कायाः
नव उदितेषु अंबुधरेषु नष्टाः |
क्षुध अर्दिता घोर विषा बिलेभ्यः
चिर उषिता विप्रसरन्ति सर्पाः
verses.iast:
aneka varṇāḥ suvinaṣṭa kāyāḥ
nava uditeṣu ambudhareṣu naṣṭāḥ |
kśudha arditā ghora viṣā bilebhyaḥ
cira uṣitā viprasaranti sarpāḥ
verses.translation: "Variously coloured and dangerously venomous snakes have contracted into their snake pits with the advent of new rain clouds, and containing in there for a long time they are highly emaciated for they are hunger-stricken, but now they are snaking out of those pits.
notes: While frogs welcome the rain snakes despise the same. In the game of hunter-hunted, snakes are now on spree for their hunt, because the festivity of frogs is over and they can fall prey to snakes. But where is the prey, namely Ravana, for the snaky arrows of Rama?

glosses.meaning: newly, emerged ones when they have come, in rainy season
for long time, stayed - in pits and holes

verses.devanagari:
चंचत् चन्द्र कर स्पर्श हर्ष उन्मीलित तारका |
अहो रागवती संध्या जहाति स्वयम् अंबरम्
verses.iast:
caṃcat candra kara sparśa harṣa unmīlita tārakā |
aho rāgavatī saṃdhyā jahāti svayam ambaram
verses.translation:
"Aha! By the touch of the moonbeam of the shining moon, the damsel called twilight is delightedly unfolding the stars releasing her ochry hue off the sky on her own, in all her love for the moon.

"Aha! By the touch of the hand of her twinkling hero a damsel in all her love to him is delightedly widening her pupils and disrobing her ochry robe on her own.

verses.devanagari:
रात्रिः शशांक उदित सौम्य वक्त्रा
तारा गण उन्मीलित चारु नेत्रा |
ज्योत्स्ना अंशुक प्रावरणा विभाति
नारी इव शुक्ल अंशुक संवृत अंगी
verses.iast:
rātriḥ śaśāṃka udita saumya vak.htrā
tārā gaṇa unmīlita cāru netrā |
jyotsnā aṃśuka prāvaraṇā vibhāti
nārī iva śukla aṃśuka saṃvṛta aṃgī
verses.translation: "Damsel-night is with the risen-moon as her genteel-face, myriad-stars as her twinkling-eyes, moonlight as her veiling-cloth, and she is glistening like the one who fully-enfolded her limbs within a whitish-cloth-like moonshine.

glosses.meaning: stars, myriad of, twinkling, with eyes

verses.devanagari:
विपक्व शालि प्रसवानि भुक्त्वा
प्रहर्षिता सारस चारु पंक्ति |
नभः समाक्रामति शीघ्र वेगा
वात अवधूता ग्रथित इव माला
verses.iast:
vipakva śāli prasavāni bhuktvā
praharṣitā sārasa cāru paṃkti |
nabhaḥ samākrāmati śīghra vegā
vāta avadhūtā grathita iva mālā
verses.translation: "On eating richly ripened yield of rice delighted are the Saarasa birds, and in a delightful bird-line with swift speed they are overrunning the sky like a stringed flowery-tassel up-heaved by wind.

verses.devanagari:
सुप्त एक हंसम् कुमुदैः उपेतम्
महा ह्रदस्थम् सलिलम् विभाति |
घनैः विमुक्तम् निशि पूर्ण चन्द्रम्
तारा गण कीर्णम् इव अंतरिक्षम्
verses.iast:
supta eka haṃsam kumudaiḥ upetam
mahā hradastham salilam vibhāti |
ghanaiḥ vimuktam niśi pūrṇa candram
tārā gaṇa kīrṇam iva aṃtarikśam
verses.translation: "One swan is sleeping in the water of a vast lake thick with white-lotuses, and that lake is glistening like the star-studded nightly skyscape that is disengaged from clouds, and that has the full-moon.
notes: Very deep and vast is the tank in which clear and unruffled water is there. On that water one white swan is sleeping around which white-lotuses are thickset. It is like the nightly autumnal vault of heaven brightened with one full moon and many stars, clear of any cloud.

glosses.meaning: skyscape, as though, appear to be.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकीर्ण हंसा अकुल मेखलानाम्
प्रबुद्ध पद्म उत्पल मालिनीनाम् |
वापीः उत्तमानाम् अधिक अद्य लक्ष्मीः
वर अंगनाम् इव भूषितानाम्
verses.iast:
prakīrṇa haṃsā akula mekhalānām
prabuddha padma utpala mālinīnām |
vāpīḥ uttamānām adhika adya lakśmīḥ
vara aṃganām iva bhūṣitānām
verses.translation: "With swans spreading and swaying around as her swaying girdle-ornaments, and with well-bloomed red and blue lotuses as her swinging flowery-tassels, the resplendence of those best tanks is now heightening as with a dame embellished with girdle-ornaments and flowery-tassels.
notes: The swaying swan-lines are the girdles of the lake-maid, and lotus-rows are her flowery tassels, and with the floating of the swans the water ruffles, then that ruffled water is ruffling those girdles and tassels on the sheet of water, thus the tank is appearing like a maiden on whose body girdles and tassels are swaying and swinging.

glosses.meaning: well, spread around, swans, swaying, as girdle
well, bloomed, pink-lotuses, blue-lotuses, as flowery-tassels

verses.devanagari:
वेणु स्वर व्यंजित तूर्य मिश्रः
प्रत्यूष काले अनिल संप्रवृत्तः |
संमूर्च्छितो गह्वर गो वृषाणाम्
अन्योन्यम् आपूरयति इव शब्दः
verses.iast:
veṇu svara vyaṃjita tūrya miśraḥ
pratyūṣa kāle anila sampravṛttaḥ |
saṃmūrcchito gahvara go vṛṣāṇām
anyonyam āpūrayati iva śabdaḥ
verses.translation: "In tune with the tunes of flute the dawn-time breeze is tuned-up, and it is spreading to broadcast the tuneful tunes from the caves, cows and bulls, and the sounds are as though surpassing one another.
notes: The dawn time bustle is indicated. At this time various tunes like the rhythmic churning of milk, cows bellowing for their calves to give milk, and bulls in rut bellowing for cows, and the fluting of the transverse flutes of cattle-boys, and the chanting of Vedic hymns that are audible like the sound emitted from mountain caves are permeating into the breeze. And the tuneful breeze is supplementing that intermixed sound, and thus all are commixed and broadcast by that breeze to the delight of the inhabitants of that locale.

glosses.meaning: flute's, tune, in tune, mixed up - tuned up
by breeze, well, started to broadcast
one another, permeating - outdoing, as though.

verses.devanagari:
नवैः नदीनाम् कुसुम प्रहासैः
व्या धूयमानैः मृदु मारुतेन |
धौत अमल क्षौम पट प्रकाशैः
कूलानि काशैः उपशोभितानि
verses.iast:
navaiḥ nadīnām kusuma prahāsaiḥ
vyā dhūyamānaiḥ mṛdu mārutena |
dhauta amala kśauma paṭa prakāśaiḥ
kūlāni kāśaiḥ upaśobhitāni
verses.translation: "The riverbanks are with smiley white flowers of new reeds that are softly swayed by the gentle breeze, and the silken reed-bed on them is shining forth like a well-washed white silk-cloth that is shiny.
notes: While the reed-beds with white flowers on either side of two banks of the river are like a white silky outfit, the two riverbanks beneath them are the two buttocks of that lady-river. Since her water is tossing against each bank, her buttocks appear swinging and thereby the silk clothe like reed-bed is swinging.

glosses.meaning: well-washed, white, silk, cloth, with shine

verses.devanagari:
वन प्रचण्डा मधु पान शौण्डाः
प्रिय अन्विताः षट् चरणाः प्रहृष्टाः |
वनेसु मत्ताः पवन अनु यात्राम्
कुर्वन्ति पद्म आसन रेणु गौराः
verses.iast:
vana pracaṇḍā madhu pāna śauṇḍāḥ
priya anvitāḥ ṣaṭ caraṇāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ |
vanesu mattāḥ pavana anu yātrām
kurvanti padma āsana reṇu gaurāḥ
verses.translation: "Honeybees that are on the loose in forests and roguish in drinking honey are yellowed with the pollen of lotuses and asana flowers when they had bouts of nectar, and they are saucily but delightedly making their journey along with their lady-loves in tow with the forest breeze.

glosses.meaning: in forest, rampant ones - on the loose
lotuses, Asana flowers', with pollen, yellowed

verses.devanagari:
जलम् प्रसन्नम् कुसुम प्रहासम्
क्रौन्च स्वनम् शालि वनम् विपक्वम् |
मृदुः च वायुः विमलः च चन्द्रः
शंसन्ति वर्ष व्यपनीत कालम्
verses.iast:
jalam prasannam kusuma prahāsam
kraunca svanam śāli vanam vipakvam |
mṛduḥ ca vāyuḥ vimalaḥ ca candraḥ
śaṃsanti varṣa vyapanīta kālam
verses.translation: "Waters are standing tranquilly, flowers are smiley, crane-birds are noisily, rice-crops are ripely, breeze is softly, and moon is brightly, thus they denote the time of rains has phased out.

verses.devanagari:
मीन उप संदर्शित मेखलानाम्
नदी वधूनाम् गतयो अद्य मंदाः |
कान्त उपभुक्त अलस गामिनीनाम्
प्रभात कालेषु इव कामिनीनाम्
verses.iast:
mīna upa sandarśita mekhalānām
nadī vadhūnām gatayo adya maṃdāḥ |
kānta upabhukta alasa gāminīnām
prabhāta kāleṣu iva kāminīnām
verses.translation: "In the dame-like rivers fish are very closely seen as if they are girdle ornaments of that dame, and nowadays these dames are strutting slothfully like ladyloves who strut tiresomely in the early morning of next day, after a nightlong romancing with their lovers.

glosses.meaning: fish, closely, very, seen, girdle ornament
with lover, on romancing, tiresomely, that are strutting

verses.devanagari:
स चक्रवाकानि स शैवलानि
काशैः दुकूलैः इव संवृतानि |
स पत्र रेखाणि स रोचनानि
वधू मुखानि इव नदी मुखानि
verses.iast:
sa cakravākāni sa śaivalāni
kāśaiḥ dukūlaiḥ iva saṃvṛtāni |
sa patra rekhāṇi sa rocanāni
vadhū mukhāni iva nadī mukhāni
verses.translation: "With Cakravaka birds, with riverweeds, and with reeds that lookalike a veiling silk-cloth, half-veiled are the river-shores and they look painted with foliage-lines in vermilion, like the faces of maidens.
notes: The face of a river is its ghat, river-shore where the holy-dips, worships etc., are performed. The citra rekhā-s are the artistic lines drawn on visible limbs with vegetable colours, namely foliages, a design in art, resembling that of leaves. It resembles the inerasable tattooing, whereas this sort of lines are crafted with vegetable colours or with the orpiment like Gorocana, which will fade away after some days, like henna mehandi. This is a handicraft of womenfolk who sophisticatedly draw the shapes of leafs, creeper-plants etc. Nowadays these leafy-lined decorations are coming as stickers.

verses.devanagari:
प्रफुल्ल बाण आसन चित्रितेषु
प्रहृष्ट षट्पदानि कूजितेषु |
गृहीत चापः उद्यत दण्ड चण्डः
प्रचण्ड चारो अद्य वनेषु कामः
verses.iast:
praphulla bāṇa āsana citriteṣu
prahṛṣṭa ṣaṭpadāni kūjiteṣu |
gṛhīta cāpaḥ udyata daṇḍa caṇḍaḥ
pracaṇḍa cāro adya vaneṣu kāmaḥ
verses.translation: "In the forest that is portrayed with the flourishing Baana and Asana trees, where the honeybees are humming elatedly, there alone the Love-god, Manmatha, is moving about unimpededly taking his bow to punish the lovesick.

glosses.meaning: flourishing, Baana, Asana trees, portrayed with
elatedly, honeybees, in which they are humming

verses.devanagari:
लोकम् सुवृष्ट्या परितोषयित्व
नदीः तटाकानि च पूरयित्वा |
निष्पन्न सस्याम् वसुधाम् च कृत्वा
त्यक्त्वा नभः तोय धराः प्रणष्टाः
verses.iast:
lokam suvṛṣṭyā paritoṣayitva
nadīḥ taṭākāni ca pūrayitvā |
niṣpanna sasyām vasudhām ca kṛtvā
tyaktvā nabhaḥ toya dharāḥ praṇaṣṭāḥ
verses.translation: "On appeasing the world with good rains, on filling the rivers and tanks, and on making the earth to derive good harvests also, clouds have dissipated forsaking the sky.

glosses.meaning: water, giver of torrents - black clouds
earth, deriving, harvests, on making, also

verses.devanagari:
दर्शयन्ति शरन् नद्यः पुलिनानि शनैः शनैः |
नव संगम सव्रीडा जघनानि इव योषितः
verses.iast:
darśayanti śaran nadyaḥ pulināni śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
nava saṃgama savrīḍā jaghanāni iva yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: "The autumnal rivers are showing their dunes slowly and slowly, as with shying brides showing hips in their new trysts, slowly and slowly.

verses.devanagari:
प्रसन्न सलिलाः सौम्य कुरराभिः विनादिताः |
चक्रवाक गण आकीर्णा विभांति सलिल आशयाः
verses.iast:
prasanna salilāḥ saumya kurarābhiḥ vināditāḥ |
cakravāka gaṇa ākīrṇā vibhāṃti salila āśayāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, gentle Lakshmana, with clear waters, well sounding fish-hawks, teeming teams of Cakravaka birds the lakes are glistening well.

verses.devanagari:
अन्योन्य बद्ध वैराणाम् जिगीषूणाम् नृपात्मज |
उद्योग समयः सौम्य पार्थिवानाम् उपस्थितः
verses.iast:
anyonya baddha vairāṇām jigīṣūṇām nṛpātmaja |
udyoga samayaḥ saumya pārthivānām upasthitaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, prince, those that are reciprocally bound by hostilities and desirous of victory, oh, gentle Lakshmana, for those kings their striving time has come up.
notes: Rama is also bound by hostile mood and anxious to start his campaign against evil as muhūrta 'opportune time...' has come. Please refer to verse 78 in this chapter for details.

glosses.meaning: for kings, came to the fore.

verses.devanagari:
इयम् सा प्रथमा यात्रा पार्थिवानाम् नृपात्मज |
न च पश्यामि सुग्रीवम् उद्योगम् वा तथा विधम्
verses.iast:
iyam sā prathamā yātrā pārthivānām nṛpātmaja |
na ca paśyāmi sugrīvam udyogam vā tathā vidham
verses.translation: "This is the starting time for invasions of the kings, but I do not even perceive Sugreeva, or his striving for any invasion as such.

verses.devanagari:
असनाः सप्त पर्णाः च कोविदाराः च पुष्पिताः |
दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाः च श्यामाः च गिरि सानुषु
verses.iast:
asanāḥ sapta parṇāḥ ca kovidārāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ |
dṛśyante bandhujīvāḥ ca śyāmāḥ ca giri sānuṣu
verses.translation: "On mountain terraces there appear flowered Asana trees, seven-leaved banana plants, Kovidaara, Bandhujiiva trees, and the Shyaama creepers.

glosses.meaning: Asana trees, seven-leaved banana plants, also

verses.devanagari:
हंस सारस चक्राह्वैः कुररैः च समंततः |
पुलिनानि अवकीर्णानि नदीनाम् पश्य लक्ष्मण
verses.iast:
haṃsa sārasa cakrāhvaiḥ kuraraiḥ ca samaṃtataḥ |
pulināni avakīrṇāni nadīnām paśya lakśmaṇa
verses.translation: "On the sand-dunes of rivers Swans, Saarasa-s, Cakravaka-s, also Kraunca birds are fully overspreading from all over, see Lakshmana.
notes: Here it is said that there is a problem with the copyist of palm-leaf books. These two verses 62 and 63 occur prior to the verse 60 in some mms. The thought of Rama is about Sugreeva as spoken at verse 61, and these two verses suddenly switching over to trees and birds, thus they are mismatching in the placement.

glosses.meaning: Swans, Saarasa-s, Cakravaka-s, Kraunca birds, also

verses.devanagari:
चत्वारो वार्षिका मासा गता वर्ष शत उपमाः |
मम शोक अभितप्तस्य तथा सीताम् अपश्यतः
verses.iast:
catvāro vārṣikā māsā gatā varṣa śata upamāḥ |
mama śoka abhitaptasya tathā sītām apaśyataḥ
verses.translation: "Four rainy months have rolled by and to me they are like a hundred years, for I have not seen Seetha, likewise I am seethed in grief.

glosses.meaning: such as I am, to me

verses.devanagari:
चक्रवाकी इव भर्तारम् पृष्टतो अनुगता वनम् |
विषमम् दण्डकारण्यम् उद्यान वनम् इव च अंगना
verses.iast:
cakravākī iva bhartāram pṛṣṭato anugatā vanam |
viṣamam daṇḍakāraṇyam udyāna vanam iva ca aṃganā
verses.translation: "Like a female Cakravaka bird that follows rearward of her husband, that lady Seetha followed her husband, that is what I am, to the precarious forest of Dandaka, as if she is going to pleasure-gardens.

glosses.meaning: husband, that is what I am
to precarious, forest, of Dandaka, forest

verses.devanagari:
प्रिया विहीने दुःख आर्ते हृत राज्ये विवासिते |
कृपाम् न कुरुते राजा सुग्रीवो मयि लक्ष्मण
verses.iast:
priyā vihīne duḥkha ārte hṛta rājye vivāsite |
kṛpām na kurute rājā sugrīvo mayi lakṣmaṇa
verses.translation: "Dear departed, kingdom plundered, rendered homeless, and one in desperate straits, such as I am Lakshmana, king Sugreeva is not benevolent to me.

glosses.meaning: in anguish, agitated - in desperate straits

verses.devanagari:
अनाथो हृत राज्यो अयम् रावणेन च धर्षितः ||
दीनो दूर गृहः कामी माम् चैव शरणम् गतः
verses.iast:
anātho hṛta rājyo ayam rāvaṇena ca dharṣitaḥ ||
dīno dūra gṛhaḥ kāmī mām caiva śaraṇam gataḥ
verses.translation: " 'He is insecure, kingdom forfeited, persecuted by Ravana, a dismal, came from a distant home, lovelorn and sought shelter in me alone...' thus Sugreeva may be thinking of me.

glosses.meaning: distanced, house - came from a distant home
shelter, gone in - thus Sugreeva may be thinking, coupled with next verse.

verses.devanagari:
इति एतैः कारणैः सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः |
अहम् वानर राजस्य परिभूतः परंतप
verses.iast:
iti etaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ saumya sugrīvasya durātmanaḥ |
aham vānara rājasya paribhūtaḥ paraṃtapa
verses.translation: "By these reasons, oh gentle Lakshmana, I am perhaps scoffed off by the spiteful king of Vanara-s Sugreeva oh, the enemy-blazer, Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
स कालम् परिसंख्याय सीतायाः परिमार्गणे |
कृतार्थः समयम् कृत्वा दुर्मतिः न अवबुध्यते
verses.iast:
sa kālam parisaṃkhyāya sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe |
kṛtārthaḥ samayam kṛtvā durmatiḥ na avabudhyate
verses.translation: "He computed the time for search of Seetha well, and entered into a treaty with me as well, but on achieving his means that base-minded one is unmindful of it.

verses.devanagari:
स किष्किंधाम् प्रविश्य त्वम् ब्रूहि वानर पुंगवम् |
मूर्खम् ग्राम्य सुखे सक्तम् सुग्रीवम् वचनात् मम
verses.iast:
sa kiṣkiṃdhām praviśya tvam brūhi vānara puṃgavam |
mūrkham grāmya sukhe saktam sugrīvam vacanāt mama
verses.translation: "Oh, enemy blazer Lakshmana, such as you are, you enter Kishkindha and upon my word speak to that arch-vanara Sugreeva, which stupid is tangled up in uncouth pleasures.

glosses.meaning: one in uncouth, pleasures, tangled up
of mine, upon word, you tell him.

verses.devanagari:
अर्थिनाम् उपपन्नानाम् पूर्वम् च अपि उपकारिणाम् |
आशाम् संश्रुत्य यो हन्ति स लोके पुरुषाधमः
verses.iast:
arthinām upapannānām pūrvam ca api upakāriṇām |
āśām saṃśrutya yo hanti sa loke puruṣādhamaḥ
verses.translation: " 'He who promises the requesters that have come under his shelter, and especially those that have cooperated earlier, but breaks that promise, and even shatters their hope, he is the worst fellow in the world.
notes: 'We are the earnest requesters for the searching for Seetha and we have come seeking your shelter for achieving that purpose through you, and earlier we have even cooperated with you, viz., in killing your enemy and in enthroning you, and to such like us you have promised hope but now breaking it off, thus you tend to become a worst individual. Hence oh, Sugreeva, do not become the worst person in the world...' Thus, Rama is putting words in the mouth of Lakshmana to be spoken to Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: who came to your fore [for your shelter]
who, breaks it - will not fulfil

verses.devanagari:
शुभम् वा यदि वा पापम् यो हि वाक्यम् उदीरितम् |
सत्येन परिगृह्णाति स वीरः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.iast:
śubham vā yadi vā pāpam yo hi vākyam udīritam |
satyena parigṛhṇāti sa vīraḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: " 'Whether it is good or bad, he who promises a word, and truthfully takes action for its accomplishment, indeed he is the champion and a best one among men.
notes: Promising in a helpless condition and unable to fulfil it in the same helpless situation does not make matters worse. But having attained a state of fulfilling that promise and not heedful of it, then the 'word-of-honour' conflict occurs.

glosses.meaning: truthfully, wholly, takes - makes it a reality
he, is [counted as] a champion, among men, a best one.

verses.devanagari:
कृतार्था हि अकृतार्थानाम् मित्राणाम् न भवन्ति ये |
तान् मृतान् अपि क्रव्यादाः कृतघ्नान् न उपभुंजते
verses.iast:
kṛtārthā hi akṛtārthānām mitrāṇām na bhavanti ye |
tān mṛtān api kravyādāḥ kṛtaghnān na upabhuṃjate
verses.translation: " 'Indeed, those that have achieved their means through their friends, but do not come to the rescue of the same friends whose means are still unachieved, the carrion-devourers will not devour even the flesh of those ingrates after their death.
notes: Here these morals are said threadbare. Whereas these are explained vividly in Maha Bharata in episodes like nāḍī jangha, and others. Thus some hold the opinion that Maha Bharata is an explanatory treatise to Ramayana because more than hundred upa ākhyāna-s 'sub-episodes' of Ramayana are incorporated in it and in detail. In detailing these episodes of Ramayana, that epic Maha Bharata has became more voluminous than this one.

glosses.meaning: un, achieved, means - to them that still have their means unachieved
will not, be - come to the rescue of friends

verses.devanagari:
नूनम् कांचन पृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे |
द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि चापस्य रूपम् विद्युत् गण उपमम्
verses.iast:
nūnam kāṃcana pṛṣṭhasya vikṛṣṭasya mayā raṇe |
draṣṭum icchasi cāpasya rūpam vidyut gaṇa upamam
verses.translation: " 'You definitely aspire to see that facet of the gold-spined bow of mine which in simile will be like a cluster of electric-discharges when I fully stretch it in war.

glosses.meaning: that has golden, in the rear-side - bow of Rama
in war, by me, fully, stretched

verses.devanagari:
घोरम् ज्या तल निर्घोषम् क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे |
निर्घोषम् इव वज्रस्य पुनः संश्रोतुम् इच्छसि
verses.iast:
ghoram jyā tala nirghoṣam kruddhasya mama saṃyuge |
nirghoṣam iva vajrasya punaḥ saṃśrotum icchasi
verses.translation: " 'Once more you desire to clearly hear that calamitous crashing boom from my bowstring, which is a soundalike with the crash of thunderbolt, when I angrily clang the unbent bowstring in a given war.

glosses.meaning: in war, of the enraged one
bowstring, from the surface of - flat, linear bowstring
once more, clearly, to hear, you are desirous of.

verses.devanagari:
कामम् एवम् गते अपि अस्य परिज्ञाते पराक्रमे |
त्वत् सहायस्य मे वीर न चिन्ता स्यात् नृपात्मज
verses.iast:
kāmam evam gate api asya parijñāte parākrame |
tvat sahāyasya me vīra na cintā syāt nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: "But, oh, prince Lakshmana, Sugreeva is fully aware of my valour... be that as it may... oh, brave one, I am not alarmed as I have you as my associate.
notes: 'Sugreeva is in complete knowledge about my valour for he testified it for himself when asking me to pierce the saala trees, lift the carcass of Dundubhi, and finally in killing Vali. He is aware as to why I killed Vali, viz., for transgressing the righteous path. Equally, that Sugreeva should be alarmed by now, for time is lapsed. Further, he should be alarmed, as I will eliminate him too, because he has gone back on his word, because a 'given word' is dearer to me. Furthermore, has he forgotten that my selfsame brother is at my side? Even then, does it not matter to him?

Another way of getting meaning is: asya parijñāte parākrame kāmam evam gate api san 'his, made, know, valour [of Sugreeva,] may be, that way, evanished, even...' 'Sugreeva's valour which was made known to me at the time of befriending, though that might have evanished...' tvat sahāyasya me cintā na syāt... 'by your help, to me, alarm, not, there...' 'Even then, I am un-alarmed as long as your help is there... Thus, oh, Lakshmana, you may tell Sugreeva that I depend less on his help, but I wish to eliminate him too, as he failed in his promise...'

glosses.meaning: perhaps, that way, happened, even if - be that as it may

verses.devanagari:
यद् अर्थम् अयम् आरंभः कृतः पर पुरम् जय |
समयम् न अभिजानाति कृतार्थः प्लवगेश्वरः
verses.iast:
yad artham ayam ārambhaḥ kṛtaḥ para puram jaya |
samayam na abhijānāti kṛtārthaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "For which reason this venture of eliminating Vali and its sequel is commenced, oh, the vanquisher of enemy-capitals, Lakshmana, and the timeframe set for it, that king of fly-jumpers Sugreeva is not recognising, as his ends are achieved.

glosses.meaning: for what, reason, this, venture [of his enthronement,] commenced
one who achieved, his ends, fly-jumpers', king - Sugreeva

verses.devanagari:
वर्षा समय कालम् तु प्रतिज्ञाय हरीश्वरः |
व्यतीतान् चतुरो मासान् विहरन् न अवबुध्यते
verses.iast:
varṣā samaya kālam tu pratijñāya harīśvaraḥ |
vyatītān caturo māsān viharan na avabudhyate
verses.translation: "But on promising to get back after rainy season that king of vanara-s is insensible to the slipping away of those four months time of rainy season, for he is wallowing in his pleasures.
notes: The Hindu season is calculated as two-month-period of Gregorian calendar and thus there are six seasons in Indian calendar. But here it said that four months time is elapsed and it is captioned to be rainy season. The commentary of Kulluka Bhatt says that four are the months for rainy season.

vārṣikām caturo māsān yathā indro abhi pra varṣati - ṣrāvaṇādīñ caturo māsāsān...When the specified season is calculated as four month period it takes part in the preceding and succeeding seasons. Thus grīṣma 'summer' takes part in vasanta 'spring' and śarat 'post rainy season' in varṣa 'rainy season' and śiśira 'cold' in hemanta 'winter' season. Thus the month to start campaigns is mārgaśira roughly 'Nov-Dec' has come, for which arrangements have to be made in kārtika 'Sept - Oct' month.

verses.devanagari:
स अमात्य परिषत् क्रीडन् पानम् एव उपसेवते |
शोक दीनेषु न अस्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम्
verses.iast:
sa amātya pariṣat krīḍan pānam eva upasevate |
śoka dīneṣu na asmāsu sugrīvaḥ kurute dayām
verses.translation: "Frolicking with all in the council of ministers Sugreeva is absorbed in drinking alone, and he is not sympathising with us who are agonised by grief.

glosses.meaning: Sugreeva, with, ministers, council of, while frolicking

verses.devanagari:
उच्यताम् गच्छ सुग्रीवः त्वया वीरः महाबल |
मम रोषस्य यत् रूपम् ब्रूयाः च एनम् इदम् वचः
verses.iast:
ucyatām gaccha sugrīvaḥ tvayā vīraḥ mahābala |
mama roṣasya yat rūpam brūyāḥ ca enam idam vacaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, great-mighty Lakshmana, you may proceed to Kishkindha and let Sugreeva know through you as to how my fury takes shape, and oh, brave one, he may be told this word also.

verses.devanagari:
न स संकुचितः पंथा येन वाली हतो गतः |
समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः
verses.iast:
na sa saṅkucitaḥ paṃthā yena vālī hato gataḥ |
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vāli patham anvagāḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, Sugreeva, abide by your commitment. The path by which slain Vali has gone is not tapered off, as such do not tread Vali's path.

verses.devanagari:
एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया |
त्वाम् तु सत्यात् अतिक्रांतम् हनिष्यामि स बान्धवम्
verses.iast:
eka eva raṇe vālī śareṇa nihato mayā |
tvām tu satyāt atikrāṃtam haniṣyāmi sa bāndhavam
verses.translation: " 'In a clash Vali is slain singly with my arrow, but I wish to slay you along with your kith and kin since you have transgressed truthfulness.

glosses.meaning: along with, kith and kin, I wish to slay.

verses.devanagari:
तत् एवम् विहिते कार्ये यत् हितम् पुरुषर्षभ |
तत् तत् ब्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठ त्वर काल व्यतिक्रमः
verses.iast:
tat evam vihite kārye yat hitam puruṣarṣabha |
tat tat brūhi naraśreṣṭha tvara kāla vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, best one among men, Lakshmana, when the mission of searching for Seetha is scheduled in this way but hampered, you speak about all things that are appropriate for us and for Sugreeva even, oh, foremost one among men, hurry up, let there be no time lapse.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men - Lakshmana
in mission - of search, this way, is scheduled - hampered

verses.devanagari:
कुरुष्व सत्यम् मम वानरेश्वर
प्रतिश्रुतम् धर्मम् अवेक्ष्य शाश्वतम् |
मा वालिनम् प्रेत गतो यम क्षयम्
त्वम् अद्य पश्येः मम चोदितः शरैः
verses.iast:
kuruṣva satyam mama vānareśvara
pratiśrutam dharmam avekṣya śāśvatam |
mā vālinam preta gato yama kṣayam
tvam adya paśyeḥ mama coditaḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, king of monkeys, on apperceiving the perpetual virtuousness in what you have promised to me, render it as a reality. Otherwise, now driven by my arrows to death, and on going to Yama, the Time-god's Inferno, you will see Vali " Thus Rama appraised Lakshmana about his thinking of Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: now, you, by my, arrows, driven
dead body, on getting - after death
to Vali, in Yama, Time-god's, house [hell,] do not, see.

verses.devanagari:
स पूर्वजम् तीव्र विवृद्ध कोपम्
लालप्यमानम् प्रसमीक्ष्य दीनम् |
चकार तीव्राम् मतिम् उग्र तेजा
हरीश्वरे मानव वंश वर्थनः
verses.iast:
sa pūrvajam tīvra vivṛddha kopam
lālapyamānam prasamīkṣya dīnam |
cakāra tīvrām matim ugra tejā
harīśvare mānava vaṃśa varthanaḥ
verses.translation: On clearly examining his elder brother Rama, who has become ruthlessly uncompassionate and pitiably prating, the mood of that intensively resplendent Lakshmana, who is an augmenter of Manu's dynasty, has become hostile towards the monkey-king Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: by far, verily intensified, with anger - who became ruthlessly uncompassionate
